opus.problem: Gives the word away. 'Your rod and Your staff' is one of the best-known phrases in the Bible, so 'the LORD's rod and this' in Psalm 23 tells most bakers the answer on its own. That is not medium hard.

The clue says 'Twelve were placed in the Tent of Meeting', but Numbers 17:8 only says Moses entered the Tent of the Testimony and found Aaron's staff had sprouted. The count of twelve and the placing in the Tent of Meeting come from Numbers 17:6-7, so the reference should be widened to cover them.
